paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: table : figure
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Cache Ratio and GSM8K Accuracy under two conditions, denoted as "No Delay" and "Delay." The x-axis is labeled "Cache Ratio" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.5, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "GSM8K Accuracy" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 20. The "No Delay" condition is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers. It begins at a Cache Ratio of approximately 0.25 with an accuracy of roughly 72, then exhibits a continuous decline, dropping to approximately 61 at a Cache Ratio of 0.37, 35 at 0.44, and concluding at its lowest recorded value of roughly 3 at a Cache Ratio of 0.49. The "Delay" condition is represented by a solid greyish-green line with square markers. It begins at a Cache Ratio of approximately 0.24 with an accuracy of roughly 74 and maintains a steady, flat trend across the measured range. It shows only minor fluctuations, reaching approximately 75 at a Cache Ratio of 0.37, dipping slightly to 74 at 0.43, returning to 75 at 0.46, and ending at roughly 74 at a Cache Ratio of 0.48.
